articles.title: INOVIO Announces FDA Accelerated Approval of VOCERYQ™, an Immunotherapy to Reduce the Frequency of Surgery in Adults with Recurrent Respiratory Papillomatosis (RRP)

articles.summary: INOVIO Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: INO), a biotechnology company focused on developing and commercializing DNA medicines to help treat and protect people from HPV-related diseases, cancer, and infectious diseases, today announced that it secured a judgment in its favor, in the amount of $80,416,101, on all claims it filed against defendants VGXI, Inc. ("VGXI") and GeneOne Life Science, Inc. ("GeneOne") in the case captioned INOVIO Pharmaceuticals, Inc. v. VGXI, Inc. and GeneOne Life Science, Inc., No. 2020-06554, in the Court of Common Pleas of Montgomery County, Pennsylvania. The Court awarded INOVIO $61,750,789 in compensatory damages and $18,665,312 in fees and costs. The Court also entered judgment against defendants on their counterclaims. INOVIO filed the case on June 3, 2020, when defendants breached the parties' Supply Agreement by refusing to honor their technology transfer obligations to enable scalable manufacturing of DNA plasmids.
